title: LCH-03 hypercare drill fixture — 0 synthetic sessions (zero control)
description: Deterministic zero-session control for the LCH-03 synthetic hypercare drill. syntheticSessionCount is 0 against a declaredThreshold of 100, so the harness computes syntheticThresholdMet = false and hypercareWindowAccepted is declared false. This fixture proves the gate is not vacuous: zero synthetic sessions can never accept a window, and no elapsed-hours-only claim can change that (elapsedHoursOnly is false and elapsedHours is informational only). hypercareStatus stays PENDING, productionAcceptance is false, incidentCadence and rollbackAuthority stay PENDING, and no SLO, error-budget, or real-traffic claim is made. It does not modify or duplicate config/current-state.json, which remains the authoritative source of truth (0/17 gates complete, 0/14 phases accepted, production pre-production, dataStage synthetic-only, scope browser-only).

authority.note: current-state remains the authoritative manifest; this drill fixture never overrides it. Acceptance here is a bounded synthetic computation (session count vs declared threshold) and never a production hypercare acceptance.

evidence.note: Zero synthetic sessions; no session identifier, endpoint, or external evidence exists or is claimed.
